name: Messages persist in the correct server and channel
description: Verifies sending a message to a selected server channel stores it and the same channel history is shown after refreshing.
steps: Sign in to Toastcord
Select a server and one of its text channels
Send a unique message
Refresh the page
expected: The last selected server/channel is restored, and the sent message remains visible after reload.

name: Member list hydrates and updates in realtime
covers: server member list fallback for the current user
member load error and retry UI
description: Verifies the right-side member list includes the current member and refreshes after another account joins or leaves a server.
steps: Actor A signs in and opens a server
Actor B joins that server using its invite
Actor A watches the right-side member list
Actor B leaves or is removed from the server
expected: Actor A sees the new member without reloading and the list updates again after removal.

name: Voice room shows participants before media connects
covers: participant list independent of media stream
description: Verifies the voice room reflects membership in the channel even while WebRTC media negotiation is still in progress.
steps: Actor A opens a voice channel and joins
Actor B opens the same voice channel
Actor B joins the channel
Actor A observes the participant stage
expected: Actor A sees Actor B as a voice participant immediately, even before audio or screen tracks arrive.

name: WebRTC audio and screen sharing negotiate safely
covers: remote audio track reception and playback
description: Verifies a two-member voice call can receive microphone audio and negotiate screen-sharing tracks without discarding simultaneous offers.
steps: Actor A and Actor B join the same voice channel from separate browsers
Grant microphone permission on both clients
Confirm each participant appears in the voice stage
Actor A starts screen sharing after the call begins
Actor B checks that the shared screen appears and remote audio playback is active
expected: The peers show up before tracks arrive, remote audio tracks are assigned to a playable stream, and screen tracks are merged into the participant stream after successful negotiation.

name: ToastLab tools work and preferences persist
covers: message bookmarks persist in local storage
poll builder prepares a chat poll
slash commands create usable chat output
Ctrl+K quick switcher and channel navigation
description: Verifies ToastLab exposes the community productivity tools and keeps its local preferences available after refresh.
steps: Sign in and open ToastLab from the sparkle button
Add a private note and change the accent color
Prepare an umfrage and choose a quick reply
Save a visible message and switch to another channel with Ctrl+K
Return to ToastLab, export the current chat, and run the system diagnosis
Refresh the page and inspect saved notes, bookmarks, and appearance
expected: ToastLab exposes the listed tools, drafts and local preferences persist, and diagnostics show the backend check results.
